create_task_instance: create a Task instance with an optional featurizer callback function
featurize_task: call featurize on a Task to get features from its featurizer or empty string
interrupt_task: call interrupt on a Task to set its interrupted flag to True
check_task_finished: call check_finished on a Task to return whether the task is finished
review_task_class: review the Task base class and its step method for subclassing
